-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.Model` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def backend.strLt (a b : GoString) : Prop :=
  go.GoStringLt a b

def backend.writebackR (W : backend.WBuf) (R : backend.RBuf) : backend.RBuf :=
  { bks := backend.wbMerge W.bks R.bks, ver := R.ver + W64 1 }

def backend.canon (es : List backend.Ent) : List backend.Ent :=
  backend.dedupLast (es.mergeSort backend.entLe)

def backend.wbMerge (W R : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent) :=
  (backend.gmapImap (fun id es => backend.canon (backend.bkOf R id ++ es)) W).union R

def backend.entsSorted (es : List backend.Ent) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise (fun a b => backend.strLt a.fst b.fst) es

def backend.wbBucketOk (seq : Option Bool) (es : List backend.Ent) : Prop :=
  seq = some false ∨ backend.entsSorted es

def backend.WBuf.Wf (W : backend.WBuf) : Prop :=
  ∀ (id : w64) (es : List backend.Ent), W.bks !! id = some es → backend.wbBucketOk (W.seq !! id) es

def backend.RBuf.reset (R : backend.RBuf) : backend.RBuf :=
  { bks := backend.bksReset R.bks, ver := R.ver }

def backend.bksReset (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent) :=
  GMap.fmap (fun x => []) (GMap.filter (fun x es => !es.isEmpty) B)

def backend.bbRange (es : List backend.Ent) (key endKey : GoString) (limit : w64) : List backend.Ent
    :=
  match List.dropWhile (fun e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst key)) es with
  | [] => []
  | e :: rest =>
    if endKey = [] then if e.fst = key then [e] else []
    else List.take (sint.Z limit).toNat (List.takeWhile (fun e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst endKey)) (e :: rest))

def backend.entLe (a b : backend.Ent) : Bool :=
  !decide (backend.strLt b.fst a.fst)

def backend.WBuf.reset (W : backend.WBuf) : backend.WBuf :=
  have B := backend.bksReset W.bks;
  { bks := B, seq := GMap.fmap (fun x => true) (GMap.filter (fun id x => decide (id ∈ B)) W.seq) }

def backend.Ent : Type :=
  GoString × GoString

def backend.gmapImap {V V' : Type} (f : w64 → V → V') (m : GMap w64 V) : GMap w64 V' :=
  { lookup := fun k => Option.map (f k) (m !! k), finite := ⋯ }

def backend.wbAdd (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (id : w64) (e : backend.Ent) : GMap w64 (List
    backend.Ent) :=
  <[id := backend.bkOf B id ++ [e]]>B

def backend.dedupLast : List backend.Ent → List backend.Ent :=
  List.brecOn x✝ backend.dedupLast._f

def backend.lastVal (es : List backend.Ent) (k : GoString) : Option GoString :=
  Option.map Prod.snd (List.find? (fun e => decide (e.fst = k)) es.reverse)

def backend.WBuf.putSeq (W : backend.WBuf) (id : w64) (e : backend.Ent) : backend.WBuf :=
  { bks := backend.wbAdd W.bks id e, seq := W.seq }

structure backend.RBuf : Type where
  bks : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)
  ver : w64

structure backend.WBuf : Type where
  bks : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)
  seq : GMap w64 Bool

def backend.RBuf.Wf (R : backend.RBuf) : Prop :=
  ∀ (id : w64) (es : List backend.Ent), R.bks !! id = some es → backend.entsSorted es

def backend.writebackW (W : backend.WBuf) (R : backend.RBuf) : backend.WBuf :=
  { bks := GMap.filter (fun id x => decide (id ∈ R.bks)) W.bks, seq := W.seq }.reset

def backend.bufBound : Nat :=
  2 ^ 60

def backend.bkOf (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (id : w64) : List backend.Ent :=
  (B !! id).getD []

def backend.WBuf.put (W : backend.WBuf) (id : w64) (e : backend.Ent) : backend.WBuf :=
  { bks := backend.wbAdd W.bks id e, seq := <[id := false]>W.seq }
